tasks.short: Discuss field conditions and cultivation changes with managers

steps.what: Confer with managers about weather, soil and proposed cultivation or chemical-use changes

tasks.design: Retain discussion of actual conditions, constraints and proposed changes with managers. Existing records in {DOCS} support the conversation; no system selects chemical applications or cultivation changes from generic weather data.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field decisions depend on local conditions and practical constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Document availability does not replace professional discussion and agreement.
tasks.still_hard: Forecast uncertainty and different field conditions complicate timing and treatment choices.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor explains what is happening on the ground and recognises when specialist advice is needed.
tasks.altitude: Planning discussion and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Frame a focused question about a proposed cultivation change

evidence.claim: Keeping contextual cultivation planning discussions human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is management discussion, excluding separate field inspection and actual application work.
No free structured soil status, spray decision or machine action is assumed.
Existing information and communication tools remain; no custom system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes.
unknowns: Local crop conditions and decision responsibilities
research_questions: Which proposed changes require further field evidence or specialist review before agreement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Contextual discussion remains counted; no hypothetical briefing-production share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Communicate harvesting or forest management plans and clarify personnel questions

tasks.design: Retain direct explanation and clarification through {TELEPHONY} and site discussions. Existing plans in {DOCS} remain references; sending a document alone does not replace checking that personnel understand the current constraints.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans need to be interpreted against actual site and schedule changes.
tasks.enabler_now: Communication tools improve access without establishing less supervisory discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Personnel may act on different revisions or misunderstand exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises confusion and makes responsibilities clear.
tasks.altitude: Forestry communication responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Identify a conflict between planned harvesting and site constraints

evidence.claim: Keeping contextual forestry-plan communication human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is communication of existing plans, not authoring a forest-management plan or providing practical equipment training.
No automatic instruction distribution or free structured acknowledgement is assumed.
Existing documents and calls remain; no custom tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no process changes. Apply this task only to relevant forestry operations.
unknowns: Plan revision and field communication arrangements
research_questions: Which schedule or procedure questions require live clarification before work proceeds?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Explanation and clarification retain time; no guessed copying or mass-notification baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect crop conditions and determine required field work

steps.what: Inspect crops, fields and plant stock for condition and development
Determine whether cultivating, spraying, weeding or harvesting needs further action

tasks.design: Retain direct crop inspection and field-work judgement. Existing guidance in {DOCS} supports assessment; no remote image or generic threshold is assumed to establish local treatment need.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field conditions vary within the same crop and can change quickly.
tasks.enabler_now: Stock and labour tools in the digest do not establish automated agronomic assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Similar visible symptoms can have different causes.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor interprets observations in context and seeks specialist confirmation when uncertain.
tasks.altitude: Inspection and field-work judgement remain unchanged.

reach.task: Describe uncertain field symptoms for assessment
reach.learn: Diagnostic observation and local treatment boundaries

evidence.claim: Keeping direct crop inspection and contextual judgement human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is inspecting and assessing need, excluding management discussion and workers' field execution.
No free structured pest label, crop maturity flag or automated spray instruction is assumed.
Existing guidance remains; no custom vision or decision tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes.
research_questions: Which observed symptoms require specialist assessment before a field-work decision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Physical inspection and judgement retain all time; no assumed sensor collection earns labour savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate relocation and setup of work-site equipment

steps.what: Assess relocation needs and agree equipment dismantling, transport and setup responsibilities
Coordinate dismantling, moving and setting up equipment at the new work site

tasks.design: Retain planning of responsibilities and on-site coordination during equipment relocation. Existing equipment instructions in {DOCS} support the crew; no model controls dismantling, transport or commissioning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relocation dependencies change with actual equipment and site conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: A planning document does not remove real-time supervisory coordination.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected site obstacles and equipment condition can invalidate the planned sequence.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor sees conflicts and obtains qualified assistance before unsafe work proceeds.
tasks.altitude: Relocation coordination responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Installation requirements and safe handoff boundaries

evidence.claim: Keeping on-site equipment-relocation coordination human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor coordination; crew dismantling, transport and installation labour are outside this focal baseline.
The equipment crew produces progress observations during existing relocation work before supervisor responses in s2. No new outside reporting task or free structured readiness flag is assumed.
Existing instructions and communication suffice; no custom scheduler is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no process changes.
unknowns: Equipment types, crew scope and new-site constraints
research_questions: Which setup dependencies require qualified on-site review rather than a fixed schedule?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Supervisory coordination retains time; crew physical labour and machine runtime are not counted as focal savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain contextual field decisions, personnel communication and equipment-relocation coordination; no removable clerical component is established here.
reach: Frame uncertain crop observations for advisers
role.ambitious_version: A supervisor who turns direct field observations into clear decisions and coordinates crews around actual site constraints.
